name: mindwire-monorepo
description: One API for every coding agent — self-hostable daemon, TypeScript SDK, and docs site.

scripts.build: bun --filter='mindwire' run build && bun --filter='@mindwire/web' run build && bun --filter='@mindwire/preview' run build
scripts.preview: bun --filter='@mindwire/web' run build && bun --filter='@mindwire/web' run serve
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter='mindwire' run build && bun --filter='mindwire' run typecheck && bun --filter='@mindwire/web' run check && bun --filter='@mindwire/preview' run check
